entities.name: CGRP+ neurons in lateral parabrachial nucleus

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.object: CGRP+ neurons in lateral parabrachial nucleus
relationships.evidence_quote: In mice subjected to SNI, nearly all of these neurons (93.25 %) were c-Fos positive (c-Fos<sup>+</sup>), indicating that they were activated.

relationships.subject: CGRP+ neurons in lateral parabrachial nucleus
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, under SNI conditions, these neurons may play a critical role in the transmission of chronic pain.

key_findings: About 26% of LPBn neurons labeled from BNST/CeA are dual-labeled, 85.49% of which are CGRP+.
93.25% of dual-projecting neurons were c-Fos+ after SNI.
